_help: Messages shown as a card on Seylumi's Home screen. Give each message a new id. Optional: title, button + link ('#/page' inside the app, 'whats-new', or a https:// address), from / until dates (YYYY-MM-DD), where ('web' or 'store'), lang (translations, e.g. {"ga": {"text": "...", "button": "..."}}). The first message that hasn't been dismissed is shown.
